core: ER protein exit and quality control
qualifier: COPII export, ER retention and ERAD retrotranslocation
name: ER protein exit control via COPII export and ERAD
rationale: All members concern deciding whether ER proteins leave (COPII cargo loading, ER exit, retention) or are retrotranslocated for ERAD, whereas confusables carry SRP/tail-anchored targeting or COPI retrograde traffic instead.

qualifier: G protein-coupled receptors signalling through Rho and Rap1
name: GPCR-driven platelet activation via Rho and Rap1
rationale: Members are platelet agonist GPCR pathways (ADP P2Y1/P2Y12, thrombin PARs, thromboxane, prostacyclin) and their G12/13-Rho and Rap1 effectors, unlike confusables built on GPVI/collagen, integrin adhesion and degranulation.

qualifier: ribonucleotide mono/di/triphosphates and pyrophosphate hydrolysis
name: Ribonucleotide phosphate interconversion and pyrophosphate turnover
rationale: Members cover kinase-mediated interconversion of ribonucleoside mono-, di- and triphosphates (ADP, GDP, GTP) plus pyrophosphate and diadenosine polyphosphate hydrolysis, distinct from inositol pyrophosphates, creatine/mitochondrial ADP transport and deoxyribonucleotide synthesis in confusables.

qualifier: oncogenic pathway mutants and negative feedback
name: RAS-RAF-MAPK cascade, oncogenic mutants and negative feedback
rationale: Members are the intracellular RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK (and ERK5/p38/atypical MAPK) relay, its RAS/RAF/MAP2K disease mutants and GAP/phosphatase feedback, whereas confusables centre on upstream receptor tyrosine kinases and PI3K/AKT.

qualifier: vasopressin signalling and aquaporins
name: Vasopressin-aquaporin control of renal water balance
rationale: Members concern vasopressin receptors, aquaporin water channels and renal water reabsorption, distinguishing them from sodium/osmotic handling, renin-angiotensin and aquaglyceroporin glycerol/urea transport in confusables.

qualifier: integrin-fibronectin focal adhesion in mesenchymal/fibroblast cells
name: Integrin-matrix adhesion and migration in mesenchymal cells
rationale: Members share integrin/syndecan adhesion to matrix, focal adhesion and stress fibre assembly, fibroblast migration and a mesenchymal YAP/TAZ matrix programme, whereas confusables emphasise Rho effector kinases, adhesion disassembly or bare ECM gene modules.

qualifier: iron, zinc, copper transport and metal detoxification
name: Iron, zinc, copper and heme homeostasis and detoxification
rationale: Members concern uptake, storage, sensing and detoxification of transition metals and heme synthesis and scavenging, setting them apart from erythrocyte gas exchange, NADPH redox and mitochondrial respiration in confusables.

qualifier: monocarboxylates, carnitine and fatty acids
name: Plasma-membrane transport of lactate, carnitine and fatty acids
rationale: Members are solute carriers and their deficiency disorders moving lactate (MCT/basigin), carnitine, fatty acids and glucose across plasma membranes, unlike pyruvate/creatine, organic ion or mitochondrial fatty acid oxidation in confusables.

qualifier: defects in GDP-mannose and dolichol-phosphate-mannose supply
name: Congenital glycosylation disorders of dolichol-phosphate-mannose supply
rationale: All members are CDGs from enzymes producing the mannose donor (PMM2, MPI, PGM1 for GDP-mannose; DOLK and DPM1-3 for dolichol-phosphate mannose), whereas confusables list later-step CDGs or normal GDP-mannose metabolism.

qualifier: Hox clusters, somites, limbs and craniofacial structures
name: Hox-driven somite, limb and craniofacial patterning
rationale: Members span Hox clusters, somitogenesis, limb, craniofacial, ear and pharyngeal-organ morphogenesis with AP-2 and neural crest, distinguishing them from neural tube, axial mesoderm and forebrain patterning in confusables.

qualifier: BH3-only activation through apoptosome and SMAC-IAP caspase release
name: Intrinsic apoptosis from BH3-only activation to apoptosome caspases
rationale: Members run from BAD/BIM/BMF/BID activation and BAX/BAK oligomerisation to cytochrome c release, apoptosome caspase activation and SMAC neutralisation of IAPs, while confusables stop at MOMP regulation or use NOXA/PUMA.

qualifier: RNA polymerase I transcription and nucleolar chromatin regulation
name: RNA polymerase I rRNA transcription and nucleolar chromatin control
rationale: Members cover Pol I initiation to termination, epigenetic rDNA control (NoRC, B-WICH, SIRT1), 5S synthesis, early pre-rRNA cleavage and MYC-driven ribosome biogenesis, unlike translation, tRNA/Pol III or Pol II transcription in confusables.

qualifier: enhanced contractility and stress-induced hypertrophy
name: Cardiac contractile enhancement and hypertrophic muscle adaptation
rationale: Members concern increasing heart rate, force and relaxation of cardiac contraction and hypertrophic adaptation of striated muscle, as opposed to calcineurin-driven proliferation/regeneration or calcium-handling negative regulation in confusables.

qualifier: potassium channels of resting and early repolarisation phases
name: Potassium channels in cardiac resting and early repolarisation phases
rationale: Members are Kir and voltage-gated K+ channels with phase 1 and phase 4 of the cardiac action potential, whereas confusables cover depolarisation, plateau/late repolarisation, conduction or two-pore/KATP channels.

qualifier: COPII export, COPI retrieval and vesicle tethering
name: COPII ER export and COPI retrieval at ER-Golgi interface
rationale: Members are COPII cargo loading and export, COPI budding for Golgi-to-ER retrieval and vesicle targeting/tethering, distinct from SRP targeting, intra-Golgi/anterograde COPI and ER quality control in confusables.

qualifier: activin branch and betaglycan (TGFBR3) regulation
name: TGF-beta and activin SMAD2/3 signalling with betaglycan regulation
rationale: Members regulate TGF-beta and activin signalling through SMAD2/3:SMAD4, including TGFBR3 coreceptor and follistatin control, unlike BMP, AMH or cancer-mutant TGF-beta receptor pathways in confusables.

qualifier: VWF binding to GPIb and collagen, ADAMTS13 cleavage
name: VWF variant defects in platelet adhesion and ADAMTS13 cleavage
rationale: All members are VWF or GP1BA variants altering VWF binding to platelet GPIb or collagen or its ADAMTS13 cleavage, unlike coagulation cascade, fibrinolysis, contact activation or basement membrane in confusables.

qualifier: K48/K63 chain removal restraining NF-kappaB
name: Deubiquitinase removal of K48/K63 chains and NF-kappaB restraint
rationale: Members are DUB families (USP, OTU, JAMM) removing K11/K48/K63 chains plus negative control of NF-kappaB and transcription factor activity, distinct from chain polymerisation, neddylation/proteasome or TNFR1 linear ubiquitination in confusables.

qualifier: tubule shaping and organelle membrane contacts
name: ER tubule shaping and organelle membrane contacts
rationale: Members concern ER tubular network bending and fusion, ER positioning and ER-plasma membrane/mitochondria tethering with Miro GTPases, unlike lipid transfer, phosphoinositide synthesis or kinesin transport in confusables.

qualifier: alveolar saccules and pneumocyte differentiation
name: Alveolar saccule formation and pneumocyte differentiation
rationale: All three members concern the saccular stage and type I/II pneumocyte differentiation, unlike branching morphogenesis, lung growth or surfactant disorders in confusables.

qualifier: p53 stabilisation and checkpoint recovery
name: G2 DNA damage checkpoint, recovery and p53 stabilisation
rationale: Members cover radiation-induced G2 checkpoint signalling, Cdc25A degradation, p53 phosphorylation/degradation control and mitotic re-entry (GTSE1, MASTL), whereas confusables emphasise p53 target transcription, G2/M cyclin events or p14ARF loss.

core: Germline and early embryonic gene regulation
qualifier: piRNA silencing, spermatogenesis and maternal-to-zygotic transition
name: Germline piRNA silencing, spermatogenesis and maternal-to-zygotic transition
rationale: Members concern germ-cell specification, piRNA transposon silencing, sperm chromatin and spermatogenesis, and zygotic genome activation, distinguishing them from imprinting/X inactivation and maternal mRNA deadenylation in confusables.

qualifier: interferon-stimulated antiviral effectors and signalling feedback
name: Type I interferon-stimulated antiviral effectors and signalling feedback
rationale: Members are interferon-alpha response genes and effectors (ISG15, OAS, PKR) with negative regulation of IFN signalling, unlike the pattern-recognition sensing and IFN induction (RIG-I, cGAS-STING, TLR, IRF3) in confusables.

qualifier: ER unfolded protein response, eIF2 kinases, NRF2 and FOXO
name: UPR, eIF2 kinase, NRF2 and FOXO stress transcription
rationale: Members span ATF6/IRE1/PERK UPR, HRI/GCN2 translational stress, mitochondrial UPR, NRF2 antioxidant programmes and FOXO regulation, distinct from HSF1 heat shock/chaperonins, p53/mTORC1 metabolism and ER targeting in confusables.

qualifier: SRP-dependent and tail-anchored membrane insertion
name: SRP and tail-anchored protein targeting into ER membrane
rationale: Members concern delivering proteins to the ER via SRP co-translational and post-translational routes and inserting tail-anchored or stop-transfer proteins, whereas confusables cover ER exit, COPII/COPI traffic and ERAD.
